title: Exclude fabricated field records
hook: Two stated cases: explore the evidential consequence of excluding invalid records.

knows: Reading the stated arithmetic assumptions and a small numerical chart
doesNotKnow: How the evidential consequence of excluding invalid records affects the stated comparison

objective: Compare the evidential consequence of excluding invalid records in two explicit finite cases; separate model arithmetic from an empirical population claim.
